newsitem.title: USA: Scotts Co says sees 1997 yr eps around $1.35.
newsitem.headline: Scotts Co says sees 1997 yr eps around $1.35.

text.p: Scotts Co said on Tuesday that it expected to achieve earnings per share in the $1.25 to $1.35 range for 1997.

"The second and third quarters have traditionally been Scotts' strongest," said chief executive Charles Berger, "and our elimination of excessive pre-season promotion and move to a 'pull' marketing strategy will concentrate our sales and earnings even more during those in-season quaters."
Scotts Co produces and markets lawn care and gardening products in the United States, Africa and Latin America.
The 'pull' marketing strategy was designed to better take advantage of its leading brands, Scotts and Miracle-Gro, the company said.
